No need to save it, thanks.

steps.instruction: Search the photo library for images (not videos) whose capture time falls inside the move-in window confirmed with the person (from 2024-02-27 to 2024-04-11). Do not use a location filter. For every photo return its file path and its capture time read from the photo metadata. Change nothing. If the window has no photos, return an empty list for that window and say so plainly.

steps.message: Successfully retrieved photos from the specified move-in window with their metadata capture times.

steps.instruction:
For each photo path returned by the search step, run the vision model on that single image with this prompt: Which part of a rented home does this photo show? Answer on the first line with exactly one label for the main subject, from this list: kitchen-oven, kitchen-counter, kitchen-sink, fridge, bathroom-tub, bathroom-sink, toilet, living-room-wall, living-room-carpet, bedroom-wall, bedroom-carpet, window, front-door, not-a-spot, unclear. Use unclear when the photo is too dark or too blurry to tell. On the second line list any other labels from the same list that are also clearly visible, separated by commas, or write none. On the third line write one sentence about visible dirt, stains, marks or damage, or write none visible. Return the path, the capture time from the search step, the main label, the other visible labels and the sentence for every photo. Do not guess a label for a photo you cannot read.
